'''Olayinka David-West''' is a Nigerian academic and Dean of [[Lagos Business School|Lagos Business School(LBS)]], [[Pan-Atlantic University]] in [[Lagos]], [[Nigeria]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=David-West |first=Olayinka |date=August 15, 2024 |title=Olayinka David-West |url=https://www.lbs.edu.ng/faculty_profiles/%e2%80%8bdavid-west-olayinka/ |website=Lagos Business School |access-date=July 12, 2024 |archive-date=June 29, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240629183044/https://www.lbs.edu.ng/faculty_profiles/%E2%80%8Bdavid-west-olayinka/ |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Ivenso |first=Nwando |date=2024-10-31 |title=Lagos Business School Announces Change in Leadership |url=https://www.lbs.edu.ng/lagos-business-school-announces-change-in-leadership/ |access-date=2025-01-14 |website=Lagos Business School |language=en-GB}}</ref> She is the program lead for the Sustainable and Inclusive Digital Financial Services (SIDFS) initiative, which is dedicated to conducting research, engaging stakeholders, and proposing policy amendments to enhance [[financial inclusion]] in Nigeria.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Olayinka David-West - Digital Transformation {{!}} Mastercard PCDE Advisory Board |url=https://www.mastercard.com/pcde/en/who-we-are/bio-olayinka-david-west.html |access-date=2024-07-12 |website=www.mastercard.com}}</ref>

David-West is LBS' fifth Dean and the second woman to hold the position, following Professor [[Enase Okonedo]] who was dean from 2009 to 2020.<ref name="BusinessDay">{{Cite news |last=BusinessDay |date=2024-10-31 |title=Lagos Business School appoints Professor Olayinka David-West as her new dean |url=https://businessday.ng/news/article/lagos-business-school-appoints-professor-olayinka-david-west-as-her-new-dean/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=2025-01-14 |newspaper=[[BusinessDay (Nigeria)|BusinessDay]]|language=en-US}}</ref> She partners with organizations such as the [[Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation|Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation]] and [[MasterCard Centre]] for Inclusive Growth to advance financial inclusion and [[entrepreneurship]] in Nigeria through the SIDFS initiative.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Olayinka David-West - NextBillion |url=https://nextbillion.net/authors/dr-olayinka-david-west/ |access-date=2024-07-12 |website=nextbillion.net}}</ref> In 2019,  David-West was appointed a Professor of Information Systems and featured in the Tech Women of Lagos exhibition as one of the leading women in Nigeria's [[financial technology]] industry.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Professor Olayinka David-West – 3i Africa Summit |url=https://www.3iafrica.com/speaker/professor-olayinka-david-west/ |access-date=2024-07-12 |language=en-US}}</ref>

She is a member of the implementation team for the Aso Accord on Economic and Financial Inclusion, an initiative, unveiled by [[Vice President of Nigeria]], [[Kashim Shettima]], designed to create a model and framework for enhancing economic and financial inclusion in Nigeria.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Release |first=Press |date=2024-07-04 |title=Opening model for economic, financial inclusion underway - Shettima |url=https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more-news/709487-opening-model-for-economic-financial-inclusion-underway-shettima.html |access-date=2024-08-13 |newspaper=[[Premium Times]]|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Operating Model For Economic, Financial Inclusion Underway – The Statehouse, Abuja |url=https://statehouse.gov.ng/news/operating-model-for-economic-financial-inclusion-underway/ |access-date=2024-08-13 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=David |date=2024-07-04 |title=Shettima launches financial inclusion initiative for a $1 trillion Nigerian economy |url=https://thesun.ng/shettima-launches-financial-inclusion-initiative-for-a-1-trillion-nigerian-economy/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=2024-08-13 |newspaper=[[The Sun (Nigeria)|The Sun]]|language=en-US}}</ref>

== Education and professional certifications ==
David-West obtained a Doctorate in [[Business administration|Business Administration]] (DBA) from [[Manchester Business School]], a Master of Science (MSc) in Business Systems Analysis and Design from [[City University, London]], and a Bachelor of Science (BSc) in [[Computer science|Computer Science]] from the [[University of Lagos]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Olayinka David-West |url=https://cenfri.org/our-team/olayinka-david-west/ |access-date=2024-07-12 |website=Cenfri |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name=":0" />

She holds professional certifications, including [[Certified Information Systems Auditor]] (CISA) and Certified in the Governance of Enterprise IT (CGEIT). As an academic advocate, she is involved with the [[Information Systems Audit and Control Association]] (ISACA). Additionally, she is a qualified practitioner of the Skills Framework for the Information Age (SFIA) and has expertise in digital money, having been certified as a digital money specialist by the Digital Frontiers Institute in collaboration with the Fletcher School of Law and Diplomacy at [[Tufts University]].<ref name="Prof. Olayinka, David-West">{{Cite web |title=Prof. Olayinka, David-West |url=https://www.standardbank.com/nigeriaassetmanagement/individual-investor/About-us/our-people/Prof-Yinka,David%E2%80%93West |access-date=2024-08-13 |website=www.standardbank.com |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Career ==

David-West has over 30 years of experience in the IT industry as well as the financial services sector.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Press - Senator Mukhail Adetokunbo Abiru |url=https://www.tokunboabiru.org/press/127 |access-date=2024-08-13 |website=www.tokunboabiru.org |language=en}}</ref> In January 2025, she succeeded Prof [[Chris Ogbechie|Chris Ogechie]], Professor of Strategy at LBS, as Dean.<ref>{{Cite web |last=David-West |title=Olayinka David-West |url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/olayinka-david-west/ |access-date=12 July 2024 |website=LinkedIn}}</ref><ref name="BusinessDay"/> Before her appointment, she served as the associate dean and senior fellow in operations and led sessions on information systems management in executive education and degree programs.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-01-09 |title=Professor Olayinka David-West Emerges 5th Dean Of Lagos Business School - Brand Communicator |url=https://brandcom.ng/2025/01/09/professor-olayinka-david-west-emerges-5th-dean-of-lagos-business-school/ |access-date=2025-01-14 |language=en-US}}</ref> She also served as an academic director, responsible for managing the faculty members and providing oversight of research and other academic activities. Additionally, she was an academic director for the Enterprise Development Centre (EDC) of the [[Pan-Atlantic University]].<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Olayinka David-West {{!}} IGI Global |url=https://www.igi-global.com/affiliate/olayinka-david-west/325169 |access-date=2024-07-12 |website=www.igi-global.com}}</ref> She began her career as the Head of Research and Development at TARA Systems Limited, and she later advanced to become the Head of e-Business at the National Bank of Nigeria.

In 2022, she joined the Advisory Board of NowNow Digital Systems Limited, an African digital banking platform providing financial services to SMEs, agents, and consumers.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Nwachukwu |first=Iheanyi |date=2022-10-18 |title=NowNow appoints David London, Henrietta Bankole-Olusina, Olayinka David-West to advisory board |url=https://businessday.ng/companies/article/nownow-appoints-david-london-henrietta-bankole-olusina-olayinka-david-west-to-advisory-board/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=2024-07-12 |newspaper=[[BusinessDay (Nigeria)|BusinessDay]]|language=en-US}}</ref> Additionally, she has published articles in journals, and speaks at fintech and finance-related conferences.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-09-19 |title=Professor Olayinka David-West of Lagos Business School will be delivering the keynote address at The Fintech Summit 2022 |url=https://techpoint.africa/2022/09/19/keynote-speaker-address-at-tfs2022/ |access-date=2024-07-12 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2018-09-28 |title=Data Science Nigeria Set To Hold AI, Financial Inclusion Summit And Bootcamp |url=https://weetracker.com/2018/09/28/data-science-nigeria-set-to-hold-ai-financial-inclusion-summit-and-bootcamp/ |access-date=2024-07-12 |website=WeeTracker |language=en}}</ref>

Olayinka David-West is a Nigerian academic and Dean of Lagos Business School(LBS), Pan-Atlantic University in Lagos, Nigeria. She is the program lead for the Sustainable and Inclusive Digital Financial Services (SIDFS) initiative, which is dedicated to conducting research, engaging stakeholders, and proposing policy amendments to enhance financial inclusion in Nigeria.
David-West is LBS' fifth Dean and the second woman to hold the position, following Professor Enase Okonedo who was dean from 2009 to 2020. She partners with organizations such as the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and MasterCard Centre for Inclusive Growth to advance financial inclusion and entrepreneurship in Nigeria through the SIDFS initiative. In 2019,  David-West was appointed a Professor of Information Systems and featured in the Tech Women of Lagos exhibition as one of the leading women in Nigeria's financial technology industry.
She is a member of the implementation team for the Aso Accord on Economic and Financial Inclusion, an initiative, unveiled by Vice President of Nigeria, Kashim Shettima, designed to create a model and framework for enhancing economic and financial inclusion in Nigeria.
